9to5Mac Daily is recorded fresh every weekday. Subscribe in Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform to get each new episode delivered as soon as it's released.

Today's stories we'll be discussing:

  • Apple tells Mac App Store developers they can now stop supporting Intel.
  • More spec details leak for next-gen iPhone Ultra, including specs, multitasking capabilities, launch timing, and more.
  • Apple paid 400% more for memory in iPhone 18 Pro, according to TrendForce.
  • OpenAI pushes back, calling its trade secrets dispute with Apple "a mess of Apple's own making."
